data.one_liner: Dart implementation of C-style sprintf formatting
data.what_it_does: Provides printf-like string formatting for Dart, supporting positional arguments, flags, width, precision, and various numeric bases. Handles Infinity, NaN, and negative numbers for hex/octal.
use_when: You need formatted strings with C printf syntax
You need positional arguments in format strings
You need consistent formatting across platforms
avoid_when: You prefer Dart's built-in string interpolation
You need advanced templating or internationalization
strengths: Supports a wide range of printf specifiers
Cross-platform (android, ios, web, windows, macos, linux)
weaknesses: Limited to printf syntax, not full templating
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import 'package:sprintf/sprintf.dart';
